summary: US stocks fell sharply Friday. The Nasdaq dropped 5.3% and the Dow had its worst week since March 2020. Reports blame AI worries, and I saw no reports of trading halts. Separately, the USDA confirmed a cyber incident that has lasted about five days.

events.title: Stocks close sharply lower Friday; Nasdaq -5.28%, S&P 500 and Dow in correction
events.impact: Friday close: Nasdaq 22,617.73 (-5.28%), S&P 500 6,910.39 (-3.7%), Dow 48,147.33 (-1.93%). Dow down 8% on the week, its worst since March 2020. Nasdaq 100 fell about 10% on the week. I saw no reports of halts.
events.stated_cause: Reports cite worries about AI spending and financing, Nvidia down about 14%, and rate fears. No technical fault or attack is reported. Price data from CNBC and Yahoo match.

events.title: Bitcoin near 62K USD, down about 10% on the week
events.impact: Coinglass shows about 61,781 (-3.3% in 24h, -9.5% in 7 days). Coinbase shows about 61,957. Fear index reads extreme fear at 11. CoinGecko shows 58.8K, which is lower than the others. No exchange outage found.
events.stated_cause: No technical or attack cause reported. The drop moves with the broader fall in stocks.

events.title: USDA confirms cyber incident; farm payment and mapping systems down about 5 days
events.impact: A USDA farm agency shut down mapping, payment and contracting systems. The farmer-payment tool was hit. The disruption was in its fifth day. Full scope is unknown.
events.stated_cause: A USDA under secretary called it a cyberthreat, not a software update, per reports. Nobody has said who did it or how.

events.title: Undersea cable fault slows internet in Pakistan
events.impact: Pakistan's telecom authority says the SEA-ME-WE 5 cable has a fault about 11 km offshore. Users see slow or patchy service. Traffic is being rerouted. Cloudflare Radar saw traffic drop by up to 36%.
events.stated_cause: Cause unknown and under investigation. Social posts claim sabotage, but that is unverified and no official source says so.

events.title: Iran and US trade strikes around Bahrain, Kuwait and the Strait of Hormuz
events.impact: Iran hit US sites in Bahrain several times and an air base in Kuwait. The US struck a missile site on Qeshm Island. Reports say new US strikes are more likely. Oil and shipping costs stay high.
events.stated_cause: Iran says it is answering US drone flights and strikes on its towers. The US calls its strikes defensive. Talks have stalled.

events.title: Officials say US outages are not a coordinated attack; cyber director fired
events.impact: Homeland Security's secretary says 98% sure it is not a cyberattack. The intelligence director said it is not a nation-state effort. Fox reports the National Cyber Director was fired after the outages. Some experts doubt it is coincidence.
events.stated_cause: Officials point to patching, router work and software bugs and name no attacker. The experts' doubts are views, not findings. The USDA incident is described as a cyberthreat.

events.title: JPMorgan says outside providers were hacked
events.impact: JPMorgan says attackers got customer info held by outside service providers. Earlier reports said about 16,000 records leaked. Payments were not disrupted.
events.stated_cause: Hackers hit outside vendors. A ransomware group reportedly leaked data. JPMorgan says this is not linked to its earlier outage.

events.title: CISA adds four actively exploited flaws to its catalog
events.impact: Affects SAP NetWeaver, Cisco Expressway, VMware vCenter and Apache Roller. Federal agencies must fix them under CISA rules. This is a routine-type notice, not an emergency directive.
events.stated_cause: CISA says it has evidence of active exploitation. It names no attacker.

events.title: Cloudflare status page still shows degraded performance
events.impact: Status feed (updated 01:14 UTC) lists Cloudflare Sites and Services as degraded, last changed 22:25 UTC Nov 20. I saw no wire report of a wide outage.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Cloudflare gave no cause in the data I saw.

connection_assessment.reasoning: The stock fall is blamed on AI worries and rates, not a fault. The USDA says it was a cyberthreat, and nobody has said who did it. The Pakistan cable fault has no stated cause. No official source links any of these.
connection_assessment.would_change_my_mind: An official statement blaming the same attacker or company, or several big systems failing at the same moment.

alert.reason: The stock drop is large but trading ran normally and has a stated market cause. No official link between incidents.

prep_note: Markets are volatile, so avoid rushed moves with savings or retirement funds. Keep some cash on hand and check bank apps before holiday travel. Expect possible delays for USDA farm payments. Check airline apps before flying.
